title: Nonthermal plasma assisted desorption and conversion of captured CO2 from atmospheric air
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00768A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Chinwendu Umeojiakor, Loukia-Pantzechroula Merkouri, Anthony Griffin, Melis S. Duyar, Zhe Qiang, Yizhi Xiang
The captured CO2 by a lime-based sorbent can be desorbed and in situ converted to CO or CH4, with CO2 conversion up to 87%, through a non-thermal dielectric-barrier discharge plasma-assisted process.
